# STEM Workshop List

## Eligibility Rules

- Include specific, single-session hands-on or guided STEM activities, not catalogs, passive videos, or multi-week courses.
- Require 100% browser execution with no software installs and no required hardware. Simulators are allowed.
- Prefer zero-login activities that start immediately (for example, at a career fair laptop).
- Allow free personal accounts only when labeled `Free account required.`
- Reject paywalls, trials, teacher class codes, school SSO, credit-card tiers, and learner API keys.

## Format Rules

- Use one flat bulleted list with no tables and no topic, age, or grade sections.
- Format each item as: `- [Name](activity-url) by Provider: Short description. Ages X-Y. [Educator guide](guide-url)`
- Link `Name` directly to the student start page, not a marketing or overview page.
- Add `Free account required.` after the age range (or description) when an account is needed.
- Omit the age range or educator guide if the provider does not publish them. Do not guess.
- Never use emojis, em dashes, or en dashes.
